ev.q: An online and local party game of teamwork and betrayal
Sneak through the vents to quickly move about the ship
the whole game relies on talking and debating
creates pure comedy in every round
every game is different so it has a lot of play-value
Pick your color, hat, visor, skin, and pet
The simple setup of doing tasks while trying to catch the Impostor
The controls are easy to learn, so anyone can jump in and play immediately
